caption: The drawing depicts a single jug rendered in shades of light brown and beige. The jug has a wide, rounded body and a pronounced lip for pouring, with a handle shaped like an animal, possibly a dog or wolf, with the head at the top and the body curving downward to attach to the lower part of the jug. The upper section of the jug is decorated with a relief pattern of grapevines, including grape clusters and leaves. The lower section of the jug features a raised scene showing a stag being chased by two dogs in a naturalistic setting with trees and foliage. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects present. The artist's signature is visible near the bottom right of the jug.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
